title: US flight disruptions: Chicago's O'Hare airport issues brief ground stop over staffing shortage
summary_full: Chicago’s O'Hare International Airport faced a brief ground stop due to staffing challenges at TRACON, which spanned from 10:40 am to 12:15 pm, coinciding with the Thanksgiving travel rush. This interruption led to the cancellation of approximately twelve flights, with delays averaging 15 minutes. This incident followed a major system glitch at Delta Air Lines, which affected more than 1,000 flights across the country during this peak travel season.
